> Experienced a bug? Have an idea or a question? You can submit a new issue! But make sure to read these guidelines first.

Before [submitting any issue](../issues), make sure that the problem you are facing is happening on the **latest** version of the patch!  
If you're unsure whether or not you have the latest version installed, you can always [download it again from here](../releases/latest).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> If your issue describes a bug that has already been fixed or a feature that already exists in the newest version, it will be disregarded.  
> If you have multiple problems with the patch, create separate issues instead of grouping all of them under a single issue.

> [!TIP]
> If you've noticed an error in some translation of the patch, please provide a suggested fix for the line in the issue, if possible.

> [!WARNING]
> **DO NOT** submit suggestions for improving custom content creation, such as new entities or gameplay features that cannot be implemented with a server plugin. It's a bad practise to force an average player to also install the patch in order to play your level/modification.  
> If you wish to add new functionality yourself, create an [entity pack](https://github.com/DreamyCecil/SE1-ExampleEntitiesLib) or even a separate modification with your levels.
